description: This PHP class 'ConsoleWatcherListener' handles various project lifecycle events such as publishing, ending, activation, and monitoring. It manages sending notifications, logging feeds, and executing specific actions based on project status and timing within the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

classes.name: ConsoleWatcherListener
classes.description: A listener class for handling project-related events such as publishing, ending, activation, and monitoring, with methods to send notifications and log activities.

methods.name: logFeedEntry
methods.description: Logs a feed entry, warning if duplicate, otherwise notes as populated.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a notification message to project owner or consultants, ensuring no duplicate events.

methods.name: onProjectPublish
methods.description: Handles project publish event, logs feed, and notifies admin and public feeds.

methods.name: onProjectEnding
methods.description: Handles project ending event, logs ending activity, and notifies.

methods.name: onProjectActive
methods.description: Handles active project event, sends advice and reminders based on campaign progress.

methods.name: onProjectWatch
methods.description: Handles project monitoring, sends reminders for contract, rewards, and campaign status.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to with their handler methods.
